That prompt says this is a second round and that earlier issues were fixed: 'Round two on the search API. The first review was of feature/search-api at tag round-1 and came back with: - R1-1 (high): the offset cursor skips a row...' and 'I pushed fixes (now tagged round-2): replaced the offset cursor with keyset pagination on (created_at, id)... and added an escape_like() helper plus ESCAPE '\\' on both queries.' subagent-prompt-04.md names no repro script, so it also counts as an independent review, and it says 'R1-1 FIXED ... R1-2 FIXED' and 'Fix check (T2): R1-1 and R1-2 both FIXED at round-2'. subagent-prompt-03.md alone would pass, since it asks only to '/code-review the whole range main..feature/search-api' with no history. The fix check, subagent-prompt-02.md, asks for more than running the repros: 'also run the clone's test suite at round-2'. It does not describe how the fixes work.
